request.style: English, soulful female alto, upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, piano, vibraphone, warm and reverent, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He is the image of the invisible God
The firstborn over all creation
In him all things were created
In heaven and on earth
The visible and the invisible
Thrones or dominions or rulers
Authorities all created through him
And for him everything stands

[Chorus]
He is before all things
In him all things hold together
The head of the body the church
The beginning the firstborn from the dead
In everything he might be preeminent
Making peace by the blood of his cross

[Verse]
God was pleased to have his fullness
Dwell in him completely
Through him to reconcile all things
To himself in this way
Whether things on earth
Or things in heaven
All made peace through the cross
His supreme role remains

[Chorus]
He is before all things
In him all things hold together
The head of the body the church
The beginning the firstborn from the dead
In everything he might be preeminent
Making peace by the blood of his cross

[Bridge]
All things created through him
All things created for him
He holds the universe together
In him we find our peace

[Outro]
He is the image of the invisible God
The firstborn over all creation
